title: Telefónica B2C Scaling Approach
summary: The available evidence addresses sector-wide AI adoption in customer care and network operations but does not contain Telefónica-specific detail on how the company is scaling its B2C business.
position: The governed evidence available covers a sector-level outlook noting that artificial intelligence adoption in network operations and customer care is expected to lower cost-to-serve across the European telecoms sector, with early adopters reporting double-digit efficiency gains in care and field operations [E1]. Responsible AI governance is identified as a prerequisite for scaling these deployments in customer-facing contexts [E1]. No Telefónica-specific B2C scaling strategy, programme or figure is present in the current compiled corporate memory.
